name: uni-shell
description: Cross-platform desktop shell for remote web applications
author: UniShell Contributors

scripts.lint: eslint src tests scripts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.build:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/windows.yml --win --publish never
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/verify-release.ts --preflight=mac --allow-unsigned-mac && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/mac.yml --mac --publish never
scripts.build:linux: node scripts/verify-release.ts --preflight=linux && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/linux.yml --linux --publish never
scripts.verify:release: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && node scripts/verify-release.ts
